_doc: Owner's standing preferences. Each entry is printed into the fact pack only if its 'quote' is still found verbatim in 'source': 'memory:<file>' (a file in TOOLSMITH_NOTES_DIR) or 'file:<absolute path>'. A preference whose quote vanished is printed as UNVERIFIED, so a stale rule cannot pass as current. These entries are examples of the shape the author uses; replace them with your own.

entries.pref: Tools must be free and open source.
Prefer free self-hosted services over paid managed gateways.
LLM spend is capped at a small one-off prepaid balance with a monthly projection alert.
Security profiles stay local-only: no third-party egress of their data. Any SaaS/cloud candidate would send data off-site.
Licences are checked from primary sources; non-commercial or source-available terms are a finding.
entries.quote: checked from the project's own LICENSE

entries.pref: Facts are gathered by scripts; the model never collects them or fills gaps by inference.
entries.quote: Facts are gathered by scripts. The model is given facts; it never collects
